Hero.Description: Ark Fiduciaire offers outsourcing solutions for your accounting, payroll, and administrative tasks. Focus on your core business while we handle the rest with expertise and confidentiality.

Presentation.Title: Administrative and finance outsourcing for SMEs
Presentation.Subtitle: Delegate, focus, grow
Intro: We take care of your accounting, payroll, and administrative management, allowing you to concentrate on your business development.
Our outsourcing solutions are flexible and tailored to your needs, ensuring efficiency and cost control.
We set simple SLAs and send a monthly status so you always know what is done.
Services: Accounting outsourcing: complete management of your bookkeeping and financial reporting
Payroll outsourcing: full payroll processing and HR administration services
Administrative management: comprehensive handling of all your administrative tasks
Process optimization: streamlining and improving your business processes for efficiency

Presentation.LongFormTitle: Outsourcing back-office work without losing control

LongFormSections.Title: Who it is for
Body: SMEs, entrepreneurs and subsidiaries that want to delegate accounting, payroll, invoicing, filing or administration without building a full internal team.
The service fits when administrative load pulls management away from the core business.

LongFormSections.Title: Possible scope
Body: Current accounting, supplier invoices, expenses, payroll, reminders, administrative documents, reporting and coordination with external partners.
The scope is documented to avoid grey areas between your team and Ark Fiduciaire.

LongFormSections.Title: Operating model
Body: We define channels, deadlines, approvals, reporting formats and escalation rules from the start.
Routines are simple, repeatable and adapted to real volume rather than a theoretical model.

LongFormSections.Title: Cost drivers and control
Body: Costs depend on transaction volume, number of contacts, tools, reporting frequency and coordination depth.
You keep visibility on processed tasks, blockers and decisions required.
